assertions: Recognition completion is handed off through sessionStorage as a bounded, schema-validated pending/ready payload.
Returning to the meals route consumes the ready candidates once and sends them through the existing human review form before persistence.
A late response from an older request cannot overwrite a newer pending or ready request.
The handoff never stores image data, credentials, provider errors, or raw model response text.
red_test: Start recognition, navigate away before the response finishes, return to meals, and recover the candidates; then verify one-shot consumption and late-response rejection in the contract tests.
green_test: npm run test:recognition -> 3 passed, 0 failed; npm run lint, npm run typecheck, and git diff --check passed.
same_case_requirement: Issue #7 no longer reports a successful toast with a missing review result after a route change; the issue remains open for external retest.
architecture_delta: Implemented the C-21-A1 session-scoped handoff boundary; no API, database entity, migration, offline queue, or image persistence added.
